title: tragopogon hayekii
intro: Tragopogon hayekii, commonly known as Hayek's salsify or prickly salsify, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, digestive problems, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Tragopogon hayekii include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which have been shown to exhibit these therapeutic actions.
